name: rebase-pr
description: Rebase the current pull request branch onto its base branch.

github-token.description: GitHub token with pull request and contents permissions.

repository.description: Repository in the format "owner/name". Defaults to the current repository.

pr-number.description: Pull request number to rebase. Defaults to the current pull request number.

autosquash.description: Whether to autosquash fixup! and squash! commits during rebase.

head-branch.description: Head branch of the rebased pull request.

base-branch.description: Base branch onto which the pull request was rebased.

pr-number.description: Pull request number that was rebased.

action.description: Action taken by the workflow (rebased, up-to-date, or skip).
